notes.title: Devlog - Fogreach: Shadow Whisperers Update - V1
notes.content:
We've been hard at work making some exciting changes to Fogreach: Shadow Whisperers! 
Here's what's new:

[olist]
[*] [b]Flashlight Battery Packs[/b]: Now you'll find battery packs scattered throughout the first house, ensuring you never run out of light when exploring the dark corners of Fogreach.
[*] [b]Jump Scares added[/b]: Brace yourself for some heart-pounding moments! We've added jump scares to keep you on your toes and heighten the suspense as you navigate through the eerie atmosphere of Fogreach.
[*] [b]Dialogue tweaks[/b]: We've fine-tuned the dialogue to enhance the narrative experience, offering deeper character development and more immersive storytelling.
[*] Unlock Fogreach: Prepare to venture into the mysterious second zone of Fogreach! With new challenges and secrets awaiting, the journey to Fogreach continues to unfold.
[*] [b]Save system in progress[/b]: We're currently working on implementing a robust save system, including the ability to save cinematic sequences. It's possible that the whole thing is still [b]buggy[/b]. Our beta testers will check this out 😛
[/olist]
Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and expand the world of Fogreach! Wishlist now on Steam to join the adventure: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825430/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825430/[/url]

🔗 [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/JRSwpm_3r7A?si=cnUnmhs3EhG2xKVz]We've been hard at work making some exciting changes to Fogreach![/url]
